title: ouratea laevigata
intro: Ouratea laevigata, commonly known as Smooth Ouratea, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, belonging to the family Ochnaceae. Smooth Ouratea has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Ouratea laevigata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
